description: This file defines a class 'FontWriter' responsible for writing font-related binary data to a stream in the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for writing various primitive types in big-endian format, managing stream position, and closing the stream.

classes.name: FontWriter
classes.description: A utility class for generating font file streams with methods to write data in big-endian format.

methods.name: FontWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the writer with a stream.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the writer and optionally the underlying stream.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Property to get or set the current position within the stream.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Writes a byte value to the stream.

methods.name: WriteShort
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit short in big-endian order.

methods.name: WriteUShort
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 16-bit short in big-endian order.

methods.name: WriteInt
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: WriteUInt
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a byte array to the stream.
